title: Trinity Ritual Contract
description: Per-ritual declaratory contract. Authority: TRINITY_RITUAL_CONSTITUTION_V1_1_RC.md Article V. One file per ritual at .ai/rituals/<ritual>/ritual.contract.json.

version.description: Contract schema version; locked at 1.0 for RC v1.1-rc.

delegated_role.description: Role responsible for executing the ritual body. NULL = Kernel-only (no delegation).

input_context.description: Path (relative to .ai/rituals/<ritual>/) of the context schema describing required inputs.

write_template.description: Path (relative to .ai/rituals/<ritual>/) of the write template, or null if the ritual writes no body.

check_template.description: Path (relative to .ai/rituals/<ritual>/) of the check template.

output_artifacts.description: Artifacts the ritual MUST produce on success (paths or path-templates).

required_checks.description: Named check predicates that must run during verification.

forbidden_actions.description: Actions explicitly forbidden inside this ritual (e.g. 'modify_audit_chain', 'semantic_synthesis').

allowed_current_states.description: States in which the ritual may be invoked (Article XVII).

allowed_next_states.description: States the ritual may transition to on success (Article XVII).

audit_events.description: Event types this ritual MUST emit. At minimum: <ritual>.invoked.

retry_owner.description: Role that owns retry attempts; typically 'same_delegated_role'.

preserve_failed_attempts.description: Article XV — failed attempts must be retained as artifacts.

audit_each_attempt.description: Article XV — each attempt must emit audit.
